description: Create a personal health symptom tracking spreadsheet. Set up 8 column headers: Date, Time, Symptom Type, Severity (1-10), Duration (minutes), Potential Trigger, Medication Taken, Notes. Format headers with bold text and background color. Apply data validation to the Severity column (values 1-10). Apply conditional formatting to Severity column: 1-3 (green), 4-7 (yellow/orange), 8-10 (red). Enter at least 5 sample symptom entries. Create a summary section starting at row 102 with formulas: Total Episodes (COUNTA), Average Severity (AVERAGE), Highest Severity (MAX). Save the spreadsheet.
